intro.headline: Data Work
intro.sub: Analytics tools and dashboards built in Google Sheets.

items.title: Dividend Growth Calculator
items.description: A dynamic dividend income projection tool modeling compounding growth, reinvestment, and monthly contributions over a customizable timeframe.

items.title: Household Budget Dashboard
items.description: A budgeting dashboard tracking planned vs. actual spending by category, with automated transaction categorization and dynamic monthly filtering.

items.title: Spell Efficiency Tracker
items.description: An efficiency calculator originally built to optimize spell choices in Elden Ring, ranking options by damage-per-resource-cost with automated tier classification.
